coder_notes: Gene therapy (DB107-RRV, a retroviral replicating vector) is an excluded intervention type; the flucytosine prodrug DB107-FC is coded experimental_monotherapy by analogy with the manual's pembrolizumab + vaccine example, but its activity depends on the vector, so candidate status is flagged for adjudication. Temozolomide is given in the low-to-high MGMT methylation arm only; the MGMT-unmethylated arm gets radiotherapy without temozolomide. MGMT status assigns patients to the two arms (enrichment), not linked to the candidate. IDH is both allowed (IDH-mutant astrocytoma or IDH-wildtype glioblastoma), so it is not an entry requirement. DGM7 is determined from a blood sample; whether it is germline or tumour is not stated, coded as exploratory. Outcomes also cite iRANO and 'PFS by biomarker status'.
